mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 48 degrees under clear skies by the Verona Public Library. The moon is currently in a new moon phase, and we expect a chilly overnight low of 39 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Regarding city infrastructure, the Mark Drive Reconstruction Project is underway. Improvements include new water mains, sanitary and storm sewers, and asphalt pavement between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, with tree planting and sidewalk installations following the construction.

We have plenty to look forward to, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's as well.
On October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where a 40-year-old man was arrested for his first O W I offence.
We have finished serving our Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough for the day. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10 AM when we feature our next flavor, Chocolate Heath Crunch.
